About this model

The T-600 High-Speed Drilling and Tapping Center is a high-efficiency, high-precision vertical CNC machine designed for drilling, tapping, milling, and fast-cycle production.

With a direct-drive spindle, a servo tool magazine, Japanese THK ball screws and linear guideways, the T-600 delivers rapid tool changes, excellent stability, and superior surface finishes.
